statements.text: Declare the supported Parallels Desktop package in the personal configuration source and verify the installed Pro-capable command-line runtime.
Create one Fedora Workstation 44 ARM64 GNOME virtual machine from a checksum-verified official image.
Use one persistent workstation with manual operating-system installation, no clones, manual startup, and temporary operator-managed snapshots only.
Keep the expanding root disk on internal storage and the expanding data disk on a dedicated sibling APFS volume with an allocation quota.
Expose the complete host external volume read-only and its Git subtree separately read-write without exposing the virtual disk backing store.
Provide lean, daily, and heavy CPU and memory profiles that refuse mutation while the virtual machine is running.
Storage preparation must identify the exact existing APFS container, remain explicit, and never delete, erase, repartition, or silently substitute a volume.
Install Parallels Tools and verify graphics, resizing, clipboard, shared folders, and recovery after Fedora kernel updates.
The personal source owns Fedora shell, Kitty, desktop applications, Atuin, package declarations, updates, and native cache placement.
The AI source owns only OpenCode, Codex CLI, Herdr, DBSCTR, and their related managed configuration on the Fedora workstation.
Clone both configuration repositories independently in the guest, apply the personal source first, and prove their managed target sets do not overlap.
Install the approved ARM64 desktop and developer tool set while leaving subjective desktop ricing for a later cycle.
Place bulky supported downloads, container state, application runtimes, IDE state, AI state, and native tool caches on the guest data disk.
Preserve application-compatible state across reinstall; reset only explicit cache groups and never automatically delete private AI state.
Authenticate 1Password, Tailscale, OpenCode, Codex CLI, and Atuin independently inside the guest without copying host credentials or sessions.
Enable tailnet SSH after explicit interactive enrollment and keep enrollment identity and policy outside public configuration.
Use the existing Atuin service, account, and encryption key while retaining a distinct guest-local database and host identity.
Provide a manual Fedora update command that performs one full package upgrade, never reboots automatically, reports reboot need, and verifies integration afterward.
Install checksum-pinned Fedora ARM64 OpenCode, Codex CLI, and Herdr runtimes with guest-local state and on-demand Herdr lifecycle.
Use the shared project worktree from only one operating system at a time and rebuild platform-specific dependencies when switching systems.
Do not add ChatGPT Desktop, an alternate compositor, automatic startup, automatic snapshots, automatic upgrades, virtual-machine clones, or desktop ricing.
The operator accepts unencrypted at-rest guest AI credentials and session state on the externally backed data disk under trusted physical custody.
Missing, substituted, unsafe, or unwritable external state fails closed without creating an internal fallback.
Qualify OpenCode and Codex CLI on the Parallels Fedora platform with exact version, configuration, isolated authentication, session, and recovery evidence.
Preserve existing uncommitted user work and keep unrelated active distribution changes outside every slice.
Each exact digest-bound Build approval includes that slice's applicable local deployment without a redundant confirmation inside the approved scope.
